column1: # The tests tools/gate.sh may rerun once after a red test run (tools/gate_reds.py rerun-plan).
# This list starts EMPTY on purpose: the flake sweep fixed every known flake (#279, #281,
# #283, #284), and a test goes on it only after the red log shows it flaky
# (python3 -I tools/gate_reds.py report), with an open issue to fix it. A row is a reviewed commit.
# Columns, tab-separated: target is the test binary as the red log names it
# (<binary>:<source path>, for example eve_invented:src/lib.rs), test is the full test path,
# issue is the open issue (#N), added is the date (YYYY-MM-DD). `report` flags a row with
# 5 or more rescues, or older than 14 days, as FIX-OR-DROP.
